source_note: 已核对为福建省莆田市仙游县西苑乡顶东湖村的东湖昭灵宫，排除长泰山重、金门及仙游其他同名宫庙。实访视频04:05、04:45、04:40分别提供全景、近正面与入口细节，均已view_image。图版取现存单殿：单檐歇山、脊中小塔状饰件、檐下斜木挡雨板与回廊美人靠；挡雨板不作为第二重瓦檐。根据现有实地记述暂列明代，缺直接梁题、测绘或官方断代证明，建造及历次修葺具体纪年待考。村1256创建及人物生卒年均非宫殿建造年。

initial_prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE line drawing. Use confident fine contours with a few finer internal structural lines. All surfaces remain WHITE; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, no broad grey shading, no crosshatching, no pencil grain, no texture, no gradient. No color, no gold, no black background. The white will become transparent and the ink the relevant dynasty color in the website.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.


Subject: Donghu Zhaoling Palace (东湖昭灵宫), Dingdonghu village, Xiyuan township, Xianyou county, Putian, Fujian. Depict ONLY the actual small rural wooden shrine visible in these photographs extracted from the same documented site visit. Image1 is the Buddha STYLE MASTER ONLY. Image2 (video04:05) is the principal complete building geometry, slightly above and to the right of its south front. Image3 (video04:45) confirms the complete nearly frontal silhouette. Image4 (video04:40) is a closer front detail for the central entrance, rain boards and wooden seating-rail enclosure.
Make a quiet, broad, low, SINGLE HALL with ONE tiled hip-and-gable roof (single eaved xieshan roof), NOT a double-eaved palace. Preserve the long slightly sagging horizontal ridge, gently upturned ridge ends and sweeping eave corners, with the small narrow stacked finial at the center of the ridge. The front roof plane is broad and very simple. Beneath its eaves preserve the characteristic continuous sloping WOODEN RAIN-BOARD apron wrapping the front and sides of the veranda: this is an inclined board screen, NOT a second tiled roof or an additional story. Its lower edge curves upward around the top of the one central rectangular entrance. Below the apron are low wooden solid panels, open horizontal timber rails and outward-curving supports of the veranda seating. Keep three railing-panel divisions to either side of the central entrance as in the full front reference; do not replace with monumental stone columns, invented windows or elaborate brackets. The entrance is open in outline only, with WHITE interior; remove its modern narrow metal barrier.
Keep the shallow rough stone foundation and a small central staircase with about four steps. Omit the separate distant forecourt terrace, white modern balustrade, incense burner, road and slope retaining wall. Draw the building only. Use an almost straight-on south facade with only a very small amount of the right side visible, verticals vertical, and retain complete outer roof tips and foundation. Preserve the authentic compact width and low proportions, roughly 1.8 to 2 times wider than total height including the finial and foundation. Do not exaggerate roof height. Remove the people, umbrella, bamboo, vegetation, cables, lamps, modern stacked tiles, signage, hanging ornaments with lettering and all text or subtitles. Preserve only the blank shape of the small plaque above the doorway.
This is a sparse contour drawing, not an engraving: leave both the tiled roof plane and the wooden rain apron mostly pure WHITE, with only a few well separated directional strokes, no repetitive full tile grid or every-board stripes. No dark windows, no hatch or stipple, no colored fills. Landscape1536x1024, full monument centered occupying80percent of canvas width, at least140pixels of clear whitespace at both sides and generous whitespace above the central finial and below the steps.

historical_sources.publisher: 不正经艺术（实地走访视频）
historical_sources.title: 沉浸式游览莆田仙游深山里的明代木构建筑瑰宝“东湖昭灵宫”
historical_sources.supports: 明确位于莆田仙游顶东湖村；文字记述单殿单檐九脊歇山，东西南三面约1.2米回廊、美人靠及挡雨板；实际画面核验外观。
historical_sources.caveat: 明代判断源于作者引用《东湖黄氏族谱》记黄天赦竖建祠宇神庙后，将未具名神庙推测为昭灵宫；族谱引文未直接写昭灵宫，不能视为精确建造纪年。

historical_sources.supports: 顶东湖村位于仙游西苑乡，与德化、永泰交界；村级地理与访谈背景。
historical_sources.caveat: 不提供昭灵宫直接建造年代。
historical_sources.title: 第三站：西苑顶东湖

site_recommendation.name: 仙游昭灵宫
site_recommendation.era: 明代 · 具体纪年待考
site_recommendation.year_note: 1500仅用于明代范围内近似排序，非实证建造年。断代暂依实地记述，待文博测绘或梁题确认。
site_recommendation.place: 福建 · 莆田 · 仙游西苑乡顶东湖村
site_recommendation.coordinate_note: 公开地图顶东湖村点位25°39′44″N、118°35′31″E换算，仅为村级近似定位，并非昭灵宫建筑中心或测绘坐标。
site_recommendation.lede: 歇山屋顶低展，斜木挡雨板沿檐下回廊铺开。木栏与美人靠围出轻巧的殿身，石台基把这座小宫托在顶东湖村的山坡上。

facts.label: 东湖古宫
facts.text: 位于福建仙游县西苑乡顶东湖村，又称东湖昭灵宫。

facts.label: 檐下回廊
facts.text: 单殿采用单檐歇山顶，檐下三面设回廊与美人靠，上覆斜木挡雨板。

facts.label: 纪年待考
facts.text: 据现有实地记述，年代暂列明代，建造与修葺纪年仍待考。
